lead: A `Core\X::member` spelling does not survive `spec_registry_coverage.rs`'s `cells()`, and the failure is silent.
body: `cells()` reads a `\` as a cell escape and re-emits it twice — `Core\Str::trim` comes back as `Core\\Str::trim` — so a member regex over its output matches nothing. Parse `docs/spec/02-php-migration.md` with `tools/nv/cmd/migration.ts`'s own `ROW` regex, transcribed into the Rust walk.
